name: 1-channel 5 V relay module (low voltage use only)
description: Switches a separate low-voltage DC load (lamp, pump, up to 30 V DC) from a GPIO. Wiremap only supports low-voltage loads.
notes: LOW VOLTAGE ONLY in Wiremap: keep the switched side at or below 30 V DC. Do not wire mains (the relay may be rated for it, the cheap board spacing is not safe).
Contact rating of the usual Songle SRD-05VDC: 10 A at 28-30 V DC (resistive). Derate for motors.
The module has a driver transistor and flyback diode for the coil. Many boards are active LOW; jumper/opto versions differ.
Coil draws about 70-80 mA from VCC: power it from 5 V, not the 3.3 V pin.

pins.name: VCC
pins.label: VCC
pins.note: 5 V coil supply, about 70-80 mA when the relay is on.

pins.name: IN
pins.label: IN
pins.note: Most boards are active LOW (relay on when IN is LOW). Some need 5 V logic to switch off reliably from a 3.3 V GPIO.

pins.name: NO
pins.label: NO
pins.note: Normally open: joined to COM when the relay is on.

pins.name: NC
pins.label: NC
pins.note: Normally closed: joined to COM when the relay is off.
